_readme: What's Good Local weekly deals feed for St. Augustine. Written by the weekly scheduled task; see CLAUDE.md.

deals.name: Lightner Museum
deals.deal: $12 admission for St. Johns County residents; $17 seniors, students and military
deals.details: Adult admission is $20; residents pay $12 with valid ID. Children 11 and under are free.

deals.name: Ripley's Red Train Tours
deals.deal: 30% off for active military, veterans and immediate family
deals.details: Mention the discount on arrival and show ID; available only at the ticket counter, not online. Does not apply to the Haunted Castle Investigation.

deals.name: Ripley's Red Train Tours
deals.deal: 50% off for St. Johns County residents
deals.details: Bring ID and buy discounted tickets at the door. Seniors over 55 get a second ticket at 50% off; resident and senior discounts do not apply to the Haunted Castle Investigation.

deals.name: St. Augustine Alligator Farm Zoological Park
deals.deal: 10% off admission for AAA, military and seniors
deals.details: Adult admission is $36.99 and children 3-11 are $21.99, before sales tax. Tickets are sold online or at the gate.

deals.name: St. Augustine Distillery
deals.deal: Free self-guided distillery tour, daily 10:30 AM-5:30 PM
deals.details: No reservation required for self-guided tours. Guests must show valid ID to take part in spirit tastings.

deals.name: Aqua Grill
deals.deal: $5 well spirits, $7 well martinis and old fashioneds, Mon-Fri 3-7 PM
deals.details: Bar only. Also $3 off wine by the glass and call spirits, and $2 off draft and bottled beer.

deals.name: Ice Plant Bar
deals.deal: $9 select cocktails and $7 house punch during happy hour
deals.details: Happy hour runs Monday to Friday 3-5 PM, Sunday to Thursday 9 PM-midnight, and Friday and Saturday 11 PM-1:30 AM.
deals.hours: Mon-Fri 3-5 PM · Sun-Thu 9 PM-12 AM · Fri-Sat 11 PM-1:30 AM

deals.name: Kingfish Grill
deals.deal: $2 off well drinks and $10 bar snacks, 4-6 PM
deals.details: Happy hour runs Wednesday through Monday, 4 to 6 PM; the restaurant is closed Tuesdays.

deals.name: Mojo BBQ Old City
deals.deal: $1 off beer and wine, $2 off signature cocktails and house liquor, Mon-Fri 3-6 PM
deals.details: Happy hour Monday to Friday, 3 to 6 PM.

deals.name: Pizzalley's Chianti Room
deals.deal: Half off draft beer, house wine and single well liquor, Mon-Fri 3-6 PM
deals.details: Happy hour applies with alcoholic drink purchase and may not be valid on certain holidays and special events.

deals.name: Taco Libre
deals.deal: $1 off beer, wine and specialty cocktails, Mon-Fri 2-6 PM
deals.details: Happy hour Monday to Friday, 2 to 6 PM. Also $4.99 High Noon and 2-for-1 house wines on Wednesdays.

deals.name: The BoatHouse
deals.deal: Half off drafts, wine and single liquor drinks, Mon-Fri 4-7 PM
deals.details: At the bar top only. Select appetizers, including some sushi, are also half off.

deals.name: The Original Cafe Eleven
deals.deal: Half-price draft beer and wine daily, 3-7 PM
deals.details: Includes select cans. Happy hour times may change when events are scheduled.

deals.name: The Reef Restaurant
deals.deal: Happy hour Mon-Sat 3-7 PM, Sun 4:30-7 PM
deals.details: Oceanfront restaurant on Coastal Highway north of Vilano Beach. Happy hour runs Monday to Saturday 3 to 7 PM and Sunday 4:30 to 7 PM.

deals.name: Aqua Grill
deals.details: Happy hour bar bites at the bar only. Also $11 P.E.I. mussels and $12 loaded fries.

deals.name: Mulligan's Pub
deals.deal: $13 lunch special: half sandwich or salad with soup or house salad
deals.details: Choose two from turkey club, BLT, two sliders, grilled cheese, Caesar salad, house salad or soup of the day.

deals.name: Taco Libre
deals.deal: $1 off tacos Tuesday, $1 off burritos Monday
deals.details: Weekly specials at both St. Augustine-area locations. Thursday has a $6.99 cocktail of the day.

deals.name: The BoatHouse
deals.deal: $15 whole Maine lobster dinner on Thursday with purchase of an appetizer

deals.name: The BoatHouse
deals.deal: 50¢ oysters on Wednesday with purchase of an appetizer
deals.details: Raw or steamed. Other weekly specials with an appetizer purchase: $12 per pound crab legs Monday and a $15 one-pound shrimp dinner Tuesday.
